editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The spin-swap discussion in [87] (almost certain swap at α=0°, no evolution when the field is longitudinal, 67% at ±45°) and the timestep/depth trade-off in [24] both match the English. A native editor would still fix four things. "Transpile" is rendered as "trasponi" in [91], which is the word for a matrix transpose, even though [55] correctly uses "transpilazione". "Circuit" appears as bare English in [24], [48], [52] and [55] but as "circuito" from [51] on, and both forms sit in the same heading in [51]. "Primitive" is masculine ("Il primitivo") in [60] but feminine ("La primitiva") in [95]. "Time slice" is left untranslated as "slice temporale" in [11] and [24].

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The caveats are kept: static-MPF coefficients do NOT depend on t, the ill-conditioned exact solution, and the approximate model coming out worse than the exact one. The treatment of MPF's gender is inconsistent. It is feminine in "Le MPF" [23], "MPF statiche" [31] and "MPF statica" [33], but masculine in "un MPF" [5], [24] and [49]. Two smaller slips: [39] has a number-agreement error, "si possono scegliere qualsiasi valore", and in [43] "yielding `order=2`" is rendered too literally as "che produce `order=2`".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The shock-validity condition in [36], the 13-vs-3021/4701 parameter comparison in [45]-[49] and the RANDOM initialization caveat in [42] all match the source. The main problem is register: the page uses plural "voi" almost everywhere (Notate, potreste, Potete, assicuratevi), which breaks the informal "tu" convention, and then switches to "Puoi" in [34], so it isn't consistent either. editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The parity/ancilla explanation ([30]-[36]), the DD/stretch caveat ([43]-[44]) and the conclusions ([72], [82], [89]) all match the English, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The remaining problems are surface-level. There are misspelled verb forms: "Traspilaremo" ([51], [54]) should be "Traspileremo" and "Intreccamo" ([31]) should be "Intrecciamo". Several terms are rendered more than one way: "Step 2" ([50]) vs "Passo 1/3/4"; "porte" ([70]) vs "gate" elsewhere; "misurazioni mid-circuit" ([82]) vs "a metà circuito"; "job" ([69]) vs "lavori" ([75], [79], [81]); and "la/le osservabile/i" ([7], [45]) vs "gli osservabili" ([78], [84]). There are also some calques: "effettivamente implementata" for "effectively implemented" ([30]) and "Un avvertimento" for "One caveat" ([43]). Register uses plural "voi" (assicuratevi, notate) with one impersonal "Si noti" ([63]).

editor_note: The translation is accurate and easy to read. It uses informal "tu" throughout ("Costruisci", "Registrati", "se non hai ancora") and handles the terms consistently: "qubit entangled", "transpilato (adattato)", "set di gate", "Simulazione con rumore". Two small edits would help. First, the title in [0] copies English title case ("Il Tuo Primo Circuito Quantistico"), but Italian headings normally capitalize only the first word. Second, [23] turns "quantum basics" into "basi della meccanica quantistica" (basics of quantum mechanics), which is narrower than the English and doesn't fit the linked course, "Basics of Quantum Information". Neither problem would mislead a learner.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The cut count 6^num_reps, the ideal values -1/+1 and the caveat "no error suppression/mitigation" all survive. Terminology is inconsistent in several places. "Gate" is "porte" in [7]-[22] and "gate" from [29] on. "Transpile" is "transpilazione" in [18] but "trasporre/trasposizione" everywhere else; that second form reads as matrix transposition, and "transpilare" is the usual term. "Observable" and "primitive" switch gender ("alcune osservabili" vs "degli osservabili"; "le primitive" vs "un primitivo"). There are also some slips: [14] is half-translated ("circuito cutting Qiskit addon"), [66] has a subject-verb agreement error, the page uses plural "voi" (Utilizzate, Notate) instead of the informal "tu" convention, and there are a few calques ("multiple istanze", "sottometteremo i job", "oltre la simulazione classica brute force").

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. The meaning matches the English throughout, including the caveat in [8] that the most probable bitstring "potrebbe non corrispondere più" to the correct expansion, and the φ=1/6 setup in [19]/[24]. The Italian carries over English title case for generic terms: "Stima della Fase Quantistica", "Trasformata di Fourier Quantistica" and "Funzione Qiskit". A native Italian editor would lowercase these, since they are ordinary nouns and not product names. There are also a few small calques: "mappare tra frazioni decimali e binarie" (better "convertire tra") and the bare noun "un unitario" (better "un operatore unitario"). Terminology (qubit di conteggio, autofase, gate, shot, backend) is consistent, and the informal "tu" holds throughout.

examples.suggested: La stima di fase quantistica (QPE) è un algoritmo fondamentale
examples.why: English title case carried over; in Italian, generic algorithm names are written in lowercase (the same applies to 'Trasformata di Fourier Quantistica' in [8] and [20]).

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The caveats in [17] and [44], the error states in [15] and the reason for skipping the simulator in [24] are all kept intact, so nothing here would mislead a learner. Terminology slips: in [30] "ancillas" becomes "ancelle" (literally "maidservants"), while [14] correctly says "qubit ancillari". [14] calques the English with "si concentrano criticamente" and "con supporto dal gruppo di Pauli". In [16] the second comparison target turns into "useremo anche il codice di ripetizione", which reads as a separate activity rather than something the results are compared against. Smaller points: "codice di bit-flip" and "codice bit-flip" alternate, step headings switch between "Passo 1." and "Passo 2:", and [38] has "a cui confronteremo" where "con cui" is correct.

examples.source: the remaining two are used as stabilizer measurement ancillas
examples.translation: i restanti due sono usati come ancelle per la misurazione degli stabilizzatori
examples.suggested: i restanti due sono usati come qubit ancillari per la misurazione degli stabilizzatori
examples.why: 'Ancelle' means maidservants and is not the Italian domain term. It also clashes with 'qubit ancillari' in [14].

examples.source: Stabilizer codes critically focus on correcting a discrete error set with support from the Pauli group
examples.translation: I codici stabilizzatori si concentrano criticamente sulla correzione di un insieme discreto di errori con supporto dal gruppo di Pauli
examples.suggested: I codici stabilizzatori mirano essenzialmente a correggere un insieme discreto di errori con supporto nel gruppo di Pauli
examples.why: 'Si concentrano criticamente' and 'supporto dal' are word-for-word calques. The mathematical sense is support *in* the Pauli group.

examples.source: and also to use of the repetition code where we only detect and correct errors after final measurement
examples.translation: e useremo anche il codice di ripetizione in cui rileviamo e correggiamo gli errori solo dopo la misurazione finale
examples.suggested: e anche con il codice di ripetizione in cui gli errori vengono rilevati e corretti solo dopo la misurazione finale
examples.why: The English makes post-measurement correction a second baseline to compare against. The Italian turns it into a separate thing we will use, so the comparison is lost.
